message: "-x" isn't the name of a branch, a tag or a full commit
"http://example.com/x.git" isn't a repository NetherForge fetches from: https://…, ssh://…, user@host:path or file://…
This dependency has both a "path" and a "git" repository: give it one
Couldn't fetch git@example.com:acme/gone.git: there's no repository at git@example.com:acme/gone.git

https://example.com/lib.git at aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa hashes to sha256:ca222c94b3ddce7526a51f20613833c0b8155857a50d7d298ab99e113ce81ebe, not the sha256:1590262bc4e3dbc84872fd5343cde9eca8c50f50cbe9ee4fff3bb2f43b6170d6 netherforge.lock pins, so it isn't loaded: either its copy in the cache was changed (delete it, and it's fetched again) or the lock was (netherforge lock --update resolves it afresh)
This dependency says nowhere to find it: give it a "path" or a "git" repository
"rev" goes with a "git" repository, not a "path"
